Bug_Title: UR: Uninitialized read of field method called from constructor of superclass (UR_UNINIT_READ_CALLED_FROM_SUPER_CONSTRUCTOR)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the constructor of class A where the method getValue() is called before the field 'value' in class B is initialized. This results in an uninitialized read of the field.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by creating an instance of class B with a null value. When the constructor of class B is called, it first calls the constructor of class A. In class A's constructor, the method getValue() is called before the field 'value' in class B is initialized, leading to a NullPointerException.
